summary:
# Fix E-KYC Verification Status and Add API Timeouts

## Overview
This change corrects E-KYC verification status updates. It also adds explicit timeouts to external E-KYC API calls. This improves system reliability and fault tolerance.

## Technical Highlights
- **src/module/e-kyc/service/e-kyc.service.ts**: Prevents incorrect user status updates for E-KYC verification.
- **src/module/e-kyc/service/e-kyc.service.ts**: Adds 15-second timeouts to all external HTTP requests.

## Impact
- **Functionality**: E-KYC verification status is now accurate. External API calls fail gracefully instead of hanging.
- **Risk**: New timeout errors may occur if external services are consistently slow.
